verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a dedicated facet search endpoint for type-ahead and autocomplete, but only over the values of a single facet, typically on filter menus. Its analytics can track search queries, yet nothing shows those queries feeding query suggestions. A 2023 community user of the Milli core also named typeahead as missing; that predates and does not directly contradict the facet-search docs. Missing for 10: query suggestions generated from real search traffic, a documented suggestions-index pattern or feature, general query autocomplete beyond facet values, and independent hands-on corroboration.
